data.content_ref: inline:Add a fourth derived label, RESIDUE, recording the standing reason a node is suspended (which attacker kept it OUT), computed as a pure annotation over the final grounded labels and the graph — not a second fixpoint. Determinism and polynomial cost are untouched because the annotation is a function of the already-unique labeling; the conjecture is that RESIDUE makes suspensions auditable and opens the door to 'standing residue' as the trigger for future re-examination without weakening the skeptical semantics.
